reason: I'd pay the 1.50 € a couple of times when I miss the bus from the station or it's running late, but I'm not signing up for 12 € a month. I've got my bus routine and I'd only use a bike when the timetable lets me down.
objection: With only 10 bikes in the whole town I can't count on one being at the station when I need it, so I can't plan around it like I plan around the bus. And 12 € a month is a lot from my first paycheck when pupils get it for 5 €.
would_change_my_mind: A few bikes always parked at the train station, plus a cheaper monthly rate for young workers or trainees like the pupil price, around 5 to 6 €.
